body.x: SOLVIT System (CEO Yeong-Goo Kim), a leader in advanced technology solutions, has been named a CES 2025 Innovation Awards Honoree in the “Smart Cities” category for its groundbreaking iSAR™ (intelligent Search and Rescue) system. This cutting-edge technology dramatically enhances rescue operations by significantly reducing search areas for individuals lost in mobile communication shadow zones, also known as "rescue dead zones."

Radio shadow zones pose critical challenges for rescue teams, as current technologies often do not pinpoint missing individuals in these areas. SOLVIT-iSAR™ tackles this issue using advanced algorithms to reduce search areas to as little as 1/25 of those required by traditional methods. This efficiency enables quicker, more precise rescues while optimizing resource use.

At CES 2025, SOLVIT System will showcase the advanced algorithms that drive iSAR™, including tools for radio coverage analysis, time series inference using call data records, and shadow area elimination through neighboring cell analysis. These fully automated processes allow rescue operators to complete professional-grade analyses in just 10 minutes, a dramatic improvement over the three hours typically required by experts. The company will also highlight user-friendly tools for command-and-control centers and mobile devices, enhancing field operations and decision-making during emergencies.

iSAR™ has already proven its capabilities, earning accolades such as Korea’s “Excellent Research and Development Innovation Product” award from the Ministry of Trade, Industry, and Energy. Since its deployment in April 2024 by Korea’s National Fire & Disaster Headquarters, the system has demonstrated exceptional reliability and efficiency, significantly improving the odds of rescuing individuals in emergencies.

Yeong-Goo Kim, Founder and CEO of SOLVIT System, expressed pride in receiving the CES Innovation Award for iSAR™. He emphasized the company’s commitment to saving lives. He highlighted the importance of CES 2025 as a platform to connect with global partners and explore opportunities for the localization of iSAR™ in different countries. Kim also noted the award’s significance in advocating for legal and institutional frameworks to provide public access to critical radio resources and time-series data.

The CES recognition underscores SOLVIT System’s commitment to addressing real-world challenges with cutting-edge technology. The iSAR™ system’s innovative approach saves time and resources and enhances the safety and efficiency of large-scale search operations. By ensuring accessibility and ease of use, the system requires only rescue targets to carry a mobile phone, eliminating the need for additional apps or devices.

SOLVIT System invites attendees to CES 2025 to experience the iSAR™ system. The company’s presence at the event highlights its dedication to revolutionizing search and rescue operations and creating impactful solutions that save lives. Established in 2007, SOLVIT System continues to drive technology innovation, serving clients such as Korea’s Agency for Defense Development and Hanwha Systems. Its recognition as a "Defense Industry Innovation Company" by Korea’s Defense Acquisition Program Administration reflects its ongoing contributions to advancing technology for societal benefit.
